facts.fact: CIPIT states the National AI Strategy 2025-2030 was launched in March 2025 by the Ministry of Information, Communications and the Digital Economy and is the framework the Cabinet committee now steers.

CIPIT reports that on 30 June 2026 the Cabinet, chaired by President Ruto at State House, established a Standing Cabinet Committee on Artificial Intelligence with the mandate of steering the national AI strategy and coordinating policy across government.

CIPIT describes a recently published Draft Kenya AI and other Emerging Technologies Policy 2026, the policy instrument the Strategy contemplates; the document gives no exact publication date, so the year is used.
